name: CNJ DataJud public API (court process metadata)
tier_rationale: Government body (A8 trusted): the National Council of Justice publishes the DataJud public API (Portaria CNJ 160/2020) and its documentation wiki; P241 provider tier trusted.

reliability.justification: Official national court statistics base fed by every tribunal; metadata only (no parties since the LGPD cleanup), sealed processes absent, and the cluster is often overloaded (26-31 s answers, shard rejections): an overload is 'could not verify', never 'no case'.

datajud.description: DataJud public API key ('APIKey atual' published by CNJ on datajud-wiki.cnj.jus.br/api-publica/acesso; Authorization: APIKey <key>). Optional: without it the module reads the published key from that official page once per run.
datajud.plan_hint: a public key CNJ publishes for everyone (not a personal account); the API terms are noncommercial (Termo de Uso v1.2 3.3/3.8): corporate use needs a licence_allow entry

datajud.title: DataJud public API: POST /api_publica_<tribunal>/_search by validated CNJ process number (Elasticsearch DSL, metadata only)

terms.quote: Termo de Uso v1.2 (27/11/2023) 3.3: a API e disponibilizada exclusivamente para fins legais, nao comerciais e autorizados; 3.8: e vedada a exploracao comercial dos dados.

datajud.licensed_alternative: a written CNJ confirmation, or a recorded legal opinion that internal incident/litigation-risk analysis is not commercial use, as a licence_allow entry for cnj.datajud (P241 cond 2)
datajud.notes: Queries only by a validated CNJ number routed by J.TR to one of the 91 api_publica_<alias> indices; never by party, name, CNPJ or CPF (terms 3.11, 4.2). Rate <= 120 req/min (terms 3.13): rate_per_second 2. Observed 2026-11-25/26: 26-31 s answers, HTTP 429 search_phase_execution_exception / es_rejected_execution_exception (queue capacity 1000) after 29.9 s, and HTTP 200 with _shards.failed 2/3 and empty hits (could not verify, never not found); 401 security_exception without a key. DataJud-derived data is never shared with third parties or exported to STIX/MISP (terms 4.6, P241 cond 8). Used by datajud.

datajud_key_page.title: DataJud wiki access page (datajud-wiki.cnj.jus.br/api-publica/acesso): the published 'APIKey atual', read at most once per run after a 401

terms.quote: Terms classes (definitions for every chair file and registry entry): 'open' = free use, internal business use included (public domain, CC0, CC BY, open government data, and permissive or copyleft licences whose obligations V3LUM meets by runtime download and attribution, A6)

datajud_key_page.notes: Official public documentation page; robots.txt answers 404 (no restriction, prep 2026-11-26). Only the key is read (strict 'APIKey atual' + Elasticsearch API key shape), never logged or cached (the page body is fetched with ttl 0), registered with the redactor (AR01). Last-Modified 2026-11-17, ETag "6afccc16-395b" on 2026-11-26; published key unchanged since 2026-11-25 (sha256 prefix a2c606ad6489).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G10-2 (P241 datajud). Off under the corporate licence profile until licence-cleared (noncommercial, P241 cond 2). Timeout 60 s (P241 cond 7 per-run deadline) and no automatic retries in the client: the module retries an overload answer once itself, inside the deadline.
